asOfLabel: Tue 22 Sep · first living-facts pack (ten-trillion Risk companion)

bullets.text: GAO: Treasury must refinance about $9.7T of maturing securities in FY2026 (roll/refinance, not pay-down).
Debt to the Penny (18 Sep 2026): TPDO ~$40.10T; debt held by the public ~$32.40T; intragovernmental ~$7.70T. Always name which stock.
30-year Treasury CMT 5.29% (Mon 21 Sep official). Six percent has not printed; watch hold through a long-term borrow date.
Treasury General Account (Fed H.4.1): Wednesday 16 Sep 2026 level ~$991.7B (week-average ended 16 Sep ~$877.0B). Cash buffer, not a buyback program.
Treasury long-end liquidity-support buybacks: at least $4B per operation in 10–20y and 20–30y nominal sectors, effective 9 Sep through 4 Nov 2026 (was $2B max).
CBO Outlook: debt held by the public ~101% of GDP in 2026 (context for 1pp full-stock thought experiment vs ~0.3% first-year cash on what rolls).

revisions.note: ERM first living-facts pack for Risk companion /risk/six-percent-that-stays/; refreshed debt (18 Sep), 10y/30y CMT (21 Sep), TGA H.4.1 (16 Sep); GAO roll + buyback + CBO from essay primaries.
